body.name: Data management and retention policy established
body.description: Retention periods and lifecycle management are defined.
body.detail: Not evidenced by the platform: a retention schedule must be set by the agency against its own evidential handling rules; the platform timestamps every record at ingest, so any schedule the agency sets is enforceable against real dates.
observations: Owned by the deploying agency; no technical check applies.
Counts as unclaimed in the readiness score until attested.
